@AndrewLampinen You are 💯 correct! 
We observed that the top directions encode the freq occuring tokens -- corr to dominant eigendirections in data -- in the pretraining data (learned early in pretraining). This mostly corresponds to the generic structure of language, not task-related info. https://t.co/I5DKylnYci
